exposure: neonatal respiratory distress syndrome (NRDS) premature infants who received pulmonary surfactant (PS) within 12 h after birth
NRDS premature infants who did not receive PS treatment
cohort: 75 NRDS children born in the Xiangyang Central Hospital from July 2015 to August 2017.
finding: Serum TGF-beta1 and IL-6 were elevated in NRDS children, and there was a positive correlation between them.
